messages:
neha (People Ops): Heads-up: Toni R. is dropping a "sampler box" (gift crate) at 9:40 and will be visiting for a quick chat at 10:00. Box is slightly oversized. Can someone meet the courier and print a one-off badge? Also asking for a window seat if possible.

omar: I can grab the courier at 9:35 and bring a dolly. Where should we leave the box if it needs short-term storage?

riley: I'll print a badge (Toni R. — Guest) and attach a temporary Wi-Fi card. Window seat sounds good, does anyone want the quiet corner instead? Quick poll: window / quiet corner / desk 12?

frontdesk-bot: Visitor pre-reg: Toni R.  ID on file. Courier ETA 9:40. Vehicle: ZYX-777.

mailroom: If box has framed merch, tag it FRAGILE and put in Locker B2. Otherwise we can keep it at the hospitality shelf for pick-up. Please add delivery to the sheet: https://redwood-internal/deliveries.

neha (People Ops): Thanks. Flag as FRAGILE just in case. Riley  window seat preferred by visitor. Can someone roll out a small rug by the door? No stairs access note: visitor needs step-free route.

omar: Dolly + rug in lobby by 9:30. I'll move the box to B2 after check-in. :truck: :package:

riley: Badge printed + Wi-Fi card (RedwoodGuest_2026). Seating poll results: window wins 3-0. Reserved the two-seater by the windows and labeled "Guest: Toni".

visitor: Toni R.: Thanks everyone! I'll aim for 9:50 with the courier. Appreciate the step-free and the window spot. See you soon. :)

neha (People Ops): Awesome. Reminder to log the delivery and any damage notes. If the courier leaves without signing, tag in #help and @neha. :heart:
